roleLabel: Shield support Mystic — tops up the lowest HP allies and branches into economy or Burn peel
bestFor: Runs that already have a damage carry and need a dedicated peeler / Shield battery
strength: Vault Spark always helps the most desperate heroes, so she stabilizes uneven boards better than selfish casters
weakness: Low personal clear — drafting Fiona as your only “carry” stalls the run

howToPlay.early: Great second or third pickup after a real damage threat exists. Buy Mana Regen so Vault Spark fires every fight.
howToPlay.mid: Right Hand = item/Shard factory. Lustrous = self-Shield + Burn revenge when Shields break. Tycoon = team Max HP stacks from casts. Pick the branch that matches your missing job.
howToPlay.late: Keep casting. Shield banners and Mystic abundance pieces matter more than random Magic unless Lustrous Burn is your damage plan.
howToPlay.positioning: Mid-back behind the tank, close enough that her Shields land on the collapsing front line — not marooned on the far wing.

abilityNotes.Vault Spark: It prioritizes lowest % HP heroes. Place your real carry where she can still see them when they dip — do not hide the carry out of practical range.

specNotes.The Right Hand: Economy path — casts create items and Shards. Take when the shop is dry and you need resources more than raw Shields.
specNotes.The Lustrous: Combat path — Shields on cast and Burn when enemies chew Shields. Take when you want Fiona to contribute damage, not only peel.
specNotes.The Tycoon: Team Max HP stacking from casts (Backup-friendly). Take when the whole board needs a health floor.

relicReasons.mystics-barrier-banner-585: Amplifies the Shield job you drafted her to do.
relicReasons.mystics-protection-banner-589: More protection tools for the same support niche.
relicReasons.mystics-abundance-engine-4005: Helps cast/economy loops on Right Hand or Tycoon turns.

faq.question: Is Fiona good in Guildrun?
faq.answer: Very good as support next to a carry. Weak as a solo early hero. Shop rule: if you have damage but keep whiting out, Fiona is the fix.

faq.question: What class is Fiona?
faq.answer: Mystic. Role focus: Shield support with economy (Right Hand), Burn peel (Lustrous), or team Max HP (Tycoon) branches.

faq.question: What relics work with Fiona?
faq.answer: Mystic Barrier/Protection banners, Abundance engines, and Arcane amplifiers for cast power.

faq.question: How do you play Fiona?
faq.answer: Stack Mana Regen, cast Vault Spark every fight, and specialize toward economy, Burn revenge, or team HP depending on what the board lacks.

tips: If your carry still dies first, move Fiona closer or add a real tank — more Magic on Fiona will not fix pathing.
Right Hand floods the inventory; have a plan for item slots (Niklas synergy is real).
